title: Sketchpad Diagram To Elements Board
description: Replace the diagram in semio/sketchpad with the elements board (@elements/board). Wire kit/design topology views to Board instead of legacy Diagram/React Flow diagram components.
summary: Replaced the Kit app diagram (React Flow `@semio/ui` Diagram) with `@elements/board` via `TopologyBoardPane`. Added `sketchpadKitBuildBoardFixture` and board event wiring (select, hover, drag, hand-tool locking). Design app diagram windows already used `DesignTopologyBoardWindow`; Playwright selectors were updated from `.react-flow` to `[data-topology-board-root] [data-testid="board-canvas"]`. Extended `TopologyBoardPane` with optional `lockedIds` for hand-tool pan mode.
